title: It's My Dream, So I Won't Give Up!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, with the Debut Race drawing near,
I headed out to the shopping district and heard a familiar voice.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Hey there, step right up, step right up!
How about some delicious carrots, everyone?!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer!
Ehehe, I'm helping out the carrot farmer mister!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
He does "direct sales" in the shopping district every now and then,
and he said he had a whole bunch left over today!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
But if we try hard, I know we can sell every last one!
Carrots are super yummy, after all!

text_block_list.name: Farmer Mister
text_block_list.text:
It's fine, Urara-chan, the thought alone is more than enough.
There's simply no way we could sell off this entire mountain of them...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry, leave it to me! If we work hard, they'll totally sell!
Step right up, get your carrots right here!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even when faced with a mountain of carrots,
Haru Urara shouted at the top of her lungs without the slightest hint of giving up.

text_block_list.name: Fishmonger Mister
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to Urara-chan, the whole street's livening up!
Well now, I can't let myself be outdone!

text_block_list.name: Greengrocer Lady
text_block_list.text:
In that case, I'm putting potatoes and onions on sale!
How about whipping up some curry or nikujaga tonight, folks?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Inspired by Haru Urara's spirited effort,
the shopping district burst with vitality in no time, and then—

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Hooray! Sold ouuut!!

text_block_list.name: Farmer Mister
text_block_list.text: Well I'll be... I never imagined we'd actually sell every last bit...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Knowing I helped share the deliciousness of carrots with everyone
makes my nose swell up with pride, boing-boing!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: F-Foooouuuund yoooouuuu!!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ah, King-chan.
Welcome, welcome! The carrots are all sold out though!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Agh, too late—wait, that's not the point!
Aren't you supposed to be in the middle of training right now?!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, sorry!
But the carrot farmer mister was in trouble, you see.

text_block_list.name: Farmer Mister
text_block_list.text:
Go easy on her, little horsegirl lady.
Urara-chan taught this old man something truly important today.

text_block_list.name: Farmer Mister
text_block_list.text: She reminded me that you should never give up, no matter the situation.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Yeah, exactly! It'd be such a waste to leave yummy carrots behind!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: I-I haven't the foggiest idea what you're talking about, but...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: *sigh*... Regardless, as long as you weren't simply slacking off, fine.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Still, leaving without a word makes everyone worry, you know!
Special Week-san was running all over the place looking for you!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Really?! I gotta hurry back and apologize to Spe-chan!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Ah, wait—?!

text_block_list.name: Fishmonger Mister
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! Urara-chan is as lively as ever.
I sure hope her dream of "taking 1st place" comes true soon.
choice_data_list: Is taking 1st place really Urara's dream?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
You didn't know? In training, in mock races—
Urara-san hasn't taken 1st place even once yet, you know?

text_block_list.name: Fishmonger Mister
text_block_list.text:
Even so, she never gets discouraged or gives up, always running
forward with a smile. She's truly an amazing kid.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
As long as you don't surrender and keep your head held high, there's always a chance.
Well, as a perennial victor, giving up is completely foreign to King, of course.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking back, Haru Urara had mentioned "1st place" so many times,
but I never realized there was such a story behind it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The reason she drew people to her... Perhaps it lay in that
pure, unfaltering dedication to reaching 1st place.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Ohohohoho... Hey, are you even listening?!
I said King is a perennial victor!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Huff, puff...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Phew~... Maybe I'll go try running on the dirt track next~!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Ah, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
The Debut Race is just around the corner!
I gotta do my best and aim for 1st place!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Haaah... I wonder what taking 1st place feels like.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Just running is so much fun, so if I actually
took 1st, I might flip completely head over heels from joy!
choice_data_list: Getting 1st place is your dream, right?
Taking 1st place is your big dream, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Yup! 'Cause I'm an Umamusume!
I wanna run and win!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I believe that as long as I do my best, I'll definitely get 1st someday!
As long as I never give up, for sure!!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
That's why I've gotta train even harder!
All right, time to go run on the dirt track!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Despite facing loss after loss, Haru Urara always stayed relentlessly positive.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She might be a bit too carefree, but I couldn't help wanting to see her win...
A feeling began to sprout inside me—
choice_data_list: How about I oversee your training?
Would you like me to oversee your training?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Huh?! Really?!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, to be honest, I never really understood training very well.
If Trainer's watching over me, I'm sure it'll go great!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Alrighty then, let's do our best with training! Woohoo!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As a Trainer, I couldn't help but want to support
an Umamusume running toward her dreams.
